scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.test: npm test --workspace client && npm test --workspace server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint --workspace client -- --fix && npm run lint --workspace server -- --fix
scripts.scripts:help:
echo "Available root scripts:
  dev           - Start both client and server concurrently
  test          - Run tests in both workspaces
  lint          - Lint both workspaces
  lint:fix      - Auto-fix lint issues in both workspaces
  format        - Format all files with Prettier
  format:check  - Check formatting without writing changes
  cypress:run   - Run Cypress E2E tests from root
  scripts:help  - Show this help message"
